d: On November 26, 2026, the Supreme Court cancelled the early release of former Bihar MP Anand Mohan, ordering him to surrender within a month. The court also struck down the Nitish Kumar government’s 2023 amendment to the Bihar Prison Manual as unconstitutional. What exactly happened on December 5, 1994, when Gopalganj DM IAS G. Krishnaiah was lynched in Muzaffarpur? Which six words were removed from Rule 481 to pave the way for Anand Mohan's remission?
